posts.title:
5 things to check
[before Sunday.]
posts.lead: Save this. Run it every week.

posts.title: The [Friday] injury report.
posts.lead: Practice reports run Wednesday to Friday: DNP, limited, full. Friday is when game statuses come out. That’s your real list.

posts.title: Byes in [every] league.
posts.lead: A starter on bye is a guaranteed zero. Check all your leagues, not just your main one.

posts.title: When do [waivers] clear?
posts.lead: Know whether today is a claim day or an instant-add day, and get your claims in before the run.

posts.title: Flex the [late] game.
posts.lead: Put a later kickoff in your flex. If an early starter gets hurt, you still have a swap left.

posts.title: Starters set, [everywhere].
posts.lead: One empty slot costs you a week. Check every lineup in every league before the first kickoff.
